# Phoenix Assistant
> Lightweight personal AI assistant with identity-aware browser control (free cloud AIs, HUD web UI).

## Project Structure
- Core runtime: `main.py`, `assistant.py`, `config.py`
- Providers: `providers.py` (Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter, GitHub Models, Cerebras, Ollama, FreeLLMAPI, Mock)
- Tools: `tools.py` (web search, browser control, notes, memory, system info, apps, security shield, automations, OS admin)
- Memory & Skills: `mind.py` (persistent memory + self-evolving skills)
- Voice I/O: `voice.py` (Windows TTS + SpeechRecognition)
- GUI: `futuristic_gui.py` (CustomTkinter desktop), `webgui/` (HUD web UI on port 8055)
- Security: `security_shield.py` (defensive: network/hosts/startup audit, firewall, process kill, logon attacks)
- Auto-updater: Separate repo `phoenix-auto-updater`

## Key Features
- Free cloud AI providers (no payment needed)
- Identity-aware browser control (Chrome/Edge/Santa profiles)
- Persistent memory + self-evolving skills
- Voice input/output
- HUD web UI (sci-fi arc-reactor style)
- Modes: DarkPhoenix (ghost), Voice (full voice), God (full tools, zero-cost)
- Security Shield (defensive only)
- Automations & OS admin (audited)
- Streaming replies + background watchdog
- Auto-updater (standalone tool)
